nodes.label: Egyptian National Curriculum
Mathematics — Preparatory 3 (English)
Unit 1 — Relations and Functions
Algebra
Use ordered pairs and their equality
nodes.description: Write and graph ordered pairs, and use equality of ordered pairs to find unknown values.

nodes.label: Find the cartesian product of two finite sets
nodes.description: Form X×Y, Y×X and X² from the definition, and compare them and their numbers of elements.

nodes.label: Represent a finite cartesian product by diagrams
nodes.description: Show a product of finite sets with an arrow diagram or a cartesian diagram.

nodes.label: Represent products of infinite sets on a coordinate net
nodes.description: Draw the perpendicular net for N×N, Z×Z, Q×Q and R×R, and read or plot ordered pairs on it.

nodes.label: Locate points of R×R by quadrant or axis
nodes.description: Use the axes and four quadrants to decide where a point of R×R lies and whether it belongs to X×X.

nodes.label: Write a relation as ordered pairs
nodes.description: Describe a relation from X to Y from a verbal statement and write it as a set of ordered pairs.

nodes.label: Represent a relation by diagrams
nodes.description: Represent a relation from X to Y with an arrow diagram and a cartesian (graph) diagram.

nodes.label: Relate a relation to the cartesian product
nodes.description: Explain that a relation from X to Y connects elements of X with elements of Y and is a subset of X × Y.

nodes.label: Find and represent a relation on a set
nodes.description: Write and represent a relation from a set to itself, R ⊂ X × X, using arrow and cartesian diagrams.

nodes.label: Decide whether a relation is a function
nodes.description: Decide whether a relation from X to Y is a function by checking that each element of X appears exactly once as a first projection, using ordered pairs, arrow diagrams or cartesian diagrams.

nodes.label: Write a function in symbols
nodes.description: Use function notation f : X → Y, f : x ↦ y and f(x) = y, and name the image of an element.

nodes.label: Represent a function by diagrams
nodes.description: Represent a function by an arrow diagram and a cartesian diagram from its rule or ordered pairs.

nodes.label: Find the domain, codomain and range
nodes.description: Identify the domain, codomain and range of a function, and recognise that the range is a subset of the codomain.

nodes.label: Identify polynomial functions and their degree
nodes.description: Decide whether a function is a polynomial and state its degree as the highest power of the variable.

nodes.label: Evaluate a polynomial function at given values
nodes.description: Find the image of a number under a polynomial function by substituting it into the rule.

nodes.label: Recognize and graph linear functions
nodes.description: Identify a linear function f(x)=ax+b and represent it graphically using a table of two or three points.

nodes.label: Represent constant functions graphically
nodes.description: Recognize a constant function f(x)=b and draw it as a line parallel to the x-axis.

nodes.label: Graph quadratic functions and describe their properties
nodes.description: Recognize f(x)=ax²+bx+c, graph it from a table of values, and find its vertex, axis of symmetry, direction of opening and maximum or minimum value.

questions.stem: Find $a$ and $b$ in each of the following: (A) $(a, b) = (-5, 9)$
solution: Equal ordered pairs have equal first projections: a = -5
Equal second projections: b = 9

questions.stem: Find $a$ and $b$ in each of the following: (B) $(a - 2, b + 1) = (2, -3)$
solution: First projections: a - 2 = 2, so a = 4
Second projections: b + 1 = -3, so b = -4

questions.stem: Find $a$ and $b$ in each of the following: (C) $(6, b - 3) = (2 - a, -1)$
solution: First projections: 6 = 2 - a, so a = -4
Second projections: b - 3 = -1, so b = 2

questions.stem: Find $a$ and $b$ in each of the following: (D) $(a - 7, 26) = (-2, b^3 - 1)$

Second projections: b^3 - 1 = 26, so b^3 = 27

solution: When $A=-1$: $\therefore B=2\times(-1)+4=2$
When $A=1$: $\therefore B=2\times 1+4=6$
When $A=2$: $\therefore B=2\times 2+4=8$

questions.stem: Which of the following functions represents polynomial: (A) $f_1(x)=x^3+x^2+3$
